en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard. The front shows a crowded outdoor swimming pool with waves, surrounded by bathers, umbrellas, and buildings in the background. At the bottom front it is captioned in Hungarian with the city name "Pécs" and the site name "Hullámfürdő" (wave bath). The reverse side has handwritten Hungarian text in blue ink, printed address lines, a Hungarian stamp depicting the Budapest central railway station building labeled "KÖZPONTI PÁLYAUDVAR BUDAPEST" and "MAGYAR POSTA", and a circular postmark. The lower center shows the printer's mark "FOTO WEINSTOCK" and the code "2833/30. SZ."
